department: Faculty of Chemistry and Food Chemistry (School of Science)

deadline.value: The chemistry page gives no closing date and refers applicants to the School of Science doctorate pages.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field: ETS discontinued the GRE Chemistry Test in May 2023.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Chemistry Test was discontinued in May 2023.

supervisor.value: A supervision agreement with your professor must be signed first, and a copy goes with the admission application.
supervisor.quote: you are obliged to sign a supervision agreement

funding.value: The pages checked do not state how many doctoral candidates are funded.

entry_route.value: Admission normally needs a Diploma, Master or Magister, generally with at least a good grade. A bachelor's holder can apply only through a pre-qualification procedure.
entry_route.quote: Admission for a doctorate is granted to graduates who have obtained a Diploma, Master or Magister degree from a university

also.quote: Holders of a Bachelor degree from a university may also be admitted for a doctorate without being required to obtain a further postgraduate degree

notes: The chemistry faculty page only refers to the School of Science pages, so its rules are the School of Science rules.
